blocks.html: Get ready to move and groove to the music of the 80’s as the English pop/rock band, China Crisis and Lotus Eaters vocalist, Peter Coyle shake up Manila with their music on July 8! Have a chance to “Meet and Greet” these artists at 2:00 p.m. at the Level 2, Main hallway of Robinsons Galleria. Over at Robinsons Magnolia, shoppers and mallers will have a chance to catch their live performance at 6:00 p.m. in the Mall’s Atrium. China Crisis is a popular English band formed in 1979 led by vocalist/keyboardist Gary Daly and guitarist Eddie Lundon. The band was part of a wave of new Liverpool acts in the late 1970s and early 1980s. Their song “Wishful Thinking” was their biggest and most well-known hit, and was included on numerous compilation albums. It was a top 20 hit in several European countries and hit number 1 on the Swedish radio chart Poporama in 1984. Peter Coyle is the vocalist for the Lotus Eaters who rocketed to fame with their first hit single “The First Picture of You” which sold more than 100,000 copies in England. He collaborated with China Crisis for his appearance in the video of the band's Acoustically Yours, performing "Here Come a Raincloud."
